name: UnQ-FE
description: Frontend for UnQ -> A Food & Drinks ordering web application. Solo capstone project developed for Strive School's Full Stack program!

paragraphs: Scan the QR code on your table, order into a cart you share with everyone sitting there, and pay for exactly the items you picked, by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal. No app to install, no waiter to wait for. The venue runs its menu, tables and payments from the same site. This is the web client; the API is UnQ-BE.
React 19 · TypeScript 6 · Vite 8 · Redux Toolkit · React Router 7 · React-Bootstrap · Recharts · Stripe Payment Element and PayPal · Vitest with Testing Library and msw

UnQ began as a five-week solo capstone in 2021 and was rebuilt in 2026: Create React App to Vite, React 17 to 19, the refresh interceptor, the shared-cart selection, card payments beside PayPal, the manager's tools, the test suite and the layout audit. Released under the MIT licence.
